$comment: Evidence map for Phase 34. Cognition is evaluated as derived intelligence over evidence; provider access remains Phase 26 and live world-model persistence remains declared.

areas.area: Cognitive reasoning produces traceable explanations without exposing chain of thought
areas.requirement: Reasoning traces identify operations and outputs, while explanations identify evidence and rationale.

areas.area: Cognitive confidence and uncertainty remain measurable
areas.requirement: Cognitive outputs expose uncertainty and calibration error rather than treating confidence as truth or authority.

areas.area: Claims require evidence and unsupported outputs are detected
areas.requirement: Supported claims are verifiable, unsupported claims fail verification, and uncited outputs are flagged as hallucination risk.
Model disagreement escalates, multi-model verification follows its declared policy, and high-risk cognition requires verification or approval.

evidence.contains: high-risk gate blocks without verification or approval

areas.area: Cognitive actions remain policy, budget and output governed
areas.requirement: Risk classification, policy precedence, budgets, quotas, output evaluation, release stages, canary limits and kill switches constrain derived intelligence.

evidence.contains: promotes only when all gates pass

areas.area: Cognitive learning and self-improvement remain supervised
areas.requirement: Unsupervised self-modification is prohibited and learning deployment requires evaluation, validation, approval and controlled deployment.

areas.area: World models and cognitive runtime execution are durable and observable
areas.requirement: World models, beliefs, goals, explanations and cognitive traces persist with provenance and are executed through authorized runtime boundaries.
